record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:158 — EventManager is built from the caller's (ctx.user) credentials, not the organizer's, so when an attendee or team admin adds guests the calendar update fails or silently misses the organizer's calendar while the DB is already updated

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, permissions allow non-organizers (team admin/owner or an attendee) to add guests. After writing new attendees to the DB via prisma.booking.update(...attendees.createMany...), it builds EventManager with the *caller* user and credentials: `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user); const eventManager = new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] });` and then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);`. The diff also shows the organizer’s credentials were already fetched in the booking include (`booking.user.include.credentials`) but are not used. This makes it likely that calendar attendee updates for the organizer’s calendar won’t be performed correctly when the caller isn’t the organizer, while the DB state is already changed.
